text: Ethics in AI is becoming a major topic as artificial intelligence grows. One key problem is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from data. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups, so fairness must be a priority. Privacy is another concern, since AI often uses large amounts of personal information. People need to know how their data is collected and used. Transparency is also important: companies should explain how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means creating technology that respects human rights and benefits everyone. Governments, developers, and users must work together to make sure AI is used safely and fairly.
